Similarly, the fact that you have received other job opportunities during your time here was a significant driver toward predicting you will leave, as this is relatively uncommon among those expected to stay. Finally, having spent 1-5 years in your current role also contributed to the "will leave" direction. This duration is typical for many employees, but combined with your broader experience and external offers, it signals that you may be ready for a change.
